_published_faq.name: How do I add Intuit Mailchimp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Intuit Mailchimp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai-inc.mailchimp.com/claude/mcp/v2. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Intuit Mailchimp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intuit Mailchimp provides these MCP tools: campaign-planner, edit-campaign, save-to-mailchimp, get-email-themes, replace-image, edit-text, apply-theme, set-active-campaign, get-enrichment, get-campaign-content, generate-image, and scrape-product-images.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Intuit Mailchimp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Intuit Mailchimp in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Intuit Mailchimp MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intuit Mailchimp requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Intuit Mailchimp is developed by Intuit Mailchimp. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
